newsAll.head: Jayden Daniels: Going to London, but may sit again Week 4

newsAll.head: De'Von Achane: Sustains season-ending ACL tear

newsAll.head: Breece Hall: Status to be updated Wednesday

newsAll.head: Courtland Sutton: Team-high 46 rec yards in comeback win
newsAll.body: Sutton caught three of seven targets for 46 yards in Sunday's 30-26 win over the Rams.
